summary: Join our specialized training on project design and proposal writing for rural development. Equip yourself with essential skills to drive community progress.
lede: Project Design and Proposal Writing for Rural Development helps you turn rural challenges into practical, fundable, and sustainable interventions. Learn to analyze needs, engage stakeholders, shape a clear theory of change, and connect problems with solutions and measurable results. Build the skills to structure logical frameworks, plan activities, develop realistic budgets, and prepare concept notes and proposals for donor calls. This hands-on course supports professionals who need to coordinate partners, secure funding, and deliver meaningful improvements in rural communities.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly design projects and write or review proposals for rural development. Whether you are a seasoned expert or new to rural development, this course will enhance your ability to create impactful projects.
audience: Rural development officers in government ministries
NGO and civil society programme managers
Project and programme officers in development organisations
modules: Foundations of Rural Development Project Design
Problem, Needs, and Stakeholder Analysis in Rural Contexts
Developing Theory of Change for Rural Development Projects
Designing Logical Frameworks (Logframes) that Work in Practice
Designing Activities, Workplans, and Implementation Strategies
Writing the Rural Development Project Proposal
Aligning with Donor Requirements and Selection Criteria
Risk Management, Sustainability, and Exit Planning
Reviewing, Refining, and Presenting Your Proposal
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of rural development concepts and some experience in project work. Familiarity with proposal writing and donor interactions is beneficial but not required.
